'''Viktor Aleksandrovich Kogan''' ({{langx|ru|Виктор Александрович Коган}}; 9 August 1936 — 21 October 2014, [[Rostov on Don|Rostov-on-Don]]) was a Russian [[chemist]]. [[Professor]], [[Doctor of Sciences|Doctor of Chemical Sciences]].

== Biography ==
Viktor Aleksandrovich Kogan was born on 9 August 1936. In 1959 he graduated from the Chemical Faculty of [[Rostov State University]]. Since 1962 he worked at the RSU; since 1978 he was a Professor, in 1983—2014 he was the Head of the Department of [[Physical chemistry|Physical]] and [[Colloid Chemistry]] of the RSU (now [[Southern Federal University]]).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.physchem.chimfak.sfedu.ru/Private/Kogan.html|title=Кафедра физхимии ЮФУ (РГУ) - Заведующий кафедрой Коган В.А.|last=Levchenkov|first=Sergey I.|website=www.physchem.chimfak.sfedu.ru|access-date=2023-10-01}}</ref>

His main scientific works are devoted to the chemistry of [[coordination complex]] of [[transition metals]] with polyfunctional organic ligands, [[magnetochemistry]] of bi-and polynuclear exchange clusters — complexes of transition metals with hydrazones and Schiff bases.<ref name=":0" />

Viktor Kogan was the author of 4 monographs and more than 600 papers and 40 invention certificates. He was a member of the editorial board of ''[[w:ru:Координационная химия (журнал)|Russian Journal of Coordination Chemistry]]''.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://famous-scientists.ru/721|title=Коган Виктор Александрович - Известные ученые|website=famous-scientists.ru|access-date=2018-05-19}}</ref>

He was a laureate of the [[State Prize of the USSR]] (1989), winner of Prize of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] named after [[Lev Chugaev]] (2003) and an [[w:ru:Заслуженный деятель науки РСФСР|Honoured Scientist of the RSFSR]].<ref name=":1" /><ref>Указ Президента РФ от 23 июля 1998 г. N 877 «О награждении государственными наградами Российской Федерации»</ref><ref>[http://www.ras.ru/win/db/award_dsc.asp?P=id-102.ln-ru Премия имени Л. А. Чугаева — список награждённых]</ref>

He died in [[Rostov-on-Don]] on 21 October 2014, aged 78.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.kp.ru/online/news/1875792/|title=Из жизни ушел выдающийся российский химик, профессор ЮФУ Виктор Коган|last=правды»|first=Илья БОГОМОЛОВ {{!}} Сайт «Комсомольской|date=2014-10-21|work=KP.RU - сайт «Комсомольской правды»|access-date=2018-05-19|language=ru}}</ref>
